messages:
Olivia Park: Hi team 1 My baby was born while I was on parental leave overseas (birth date 2026-02-10). I missed open enrollment window. Is this a qualifying life event? I dont have a US birth certificate or SSN yet  hospital issued a local birth record only. Need to add to medical/dental. Any deadlines for submitting docs?
Miguel Torres: Congrats Olivia! Birth is a QLE  you have 30 days from the birth to request enrollment. Since the birth occurred abroad the carrier will accept the local hospital birth record or temporary birth certificate plus passport application receipt as interim proof. Final US birth certificate/SSN can be added later.
Olivia Park: Great, thanks. Can coverage be effective retro to the birth date? Will payroll do retro deductions while I'm on leave (paid via US payroll but paid partially through parental pay)?
Jenna Li: Coverage can be retro to the birth date if we receive docs within the 30-day QLE window. Payroll: premiums will be prorated back to that effective date and deducted on the next US payroll run. If you're receiving company parental pay, we'll coordinate to avoid double-withholding. If any payroll adjustments are needed well notify you before deduction.
Olivia Park: Do I need to upload SSN now? It will be pending for a few weeks. Also worried about ID cards being mailed to my US address while I'm abroad.
Miguel Torres: SSN not required at enrollment. Enroll now with the hospital record; add SSN later. For ID cards, carriers can often issue temporary e-cards or ship to a US mailing address. If you want physical cards held until you return, note that in the portal upload comments and well request that. Otherwise opt for e-card access in the carrier app.
Payroll Bot: Heads up: If premiums are prorated back and youve taken unpaid leave days, payroll may net the premium against any upcoming paychecks. People Ops will flag to Payroll to minimize surprise.
Olivia Park: Where do I upload the docs? And is there a special note for international documents (translations/notarization)?
Miguel Torres: Upload via benefits portal > Add dependent (QLE) and choose "Birth - international". Attach hospital birth record + passport application or translation if the document isn't in English. No apostille required for initial enrollment; carriers may request certified translation later. Link: https://benefits.redwood.example/upload
Olivia Park: Uploaded files: hospital_birth_021026.jpg, passport_app_receipt_021126.pdf. Marked "birth international" in comments.
People Ops Bot: Ticket #BP-7788 created for Olivia Park. People Ops will review within 1 business day.
Jenna Li: I see the upload. Ill submit the enrollment request and request carrier e-card access. Effective date set to 2026-02-10 pending carrier acceptance. Payroll will be notified to prorate premiums and coordinate with parental pay. Expect confirmation by EOD tomorrow.
Olivia Park: Thank you 49a. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
Miguel Torres: Congrats again. If the carrier asks for additional documentation (e.g., US birth certificate once available) well follow up via this ticket.
